description: `cli service capabilities --help` prints its generated topic.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli service capabilities [OPTIONS]

Print the grammar, exit codes by error code, environment variables and every command on one page. Makes no request.

Options:
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli service capabilities --json
  prose cli service capabilities

Output: openprose.service-capabilities/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration.
